hitl.scope: experimental scenario label prediction; not plant HEP

cog_pvt.scope: vigilance-task error flags, not industrial error probability

cog_monitoring.scope: distribution conditional on observed response; missing-opportunity denominator not inferred

process_context.scope: real/simulated signal ingestion and causal alarm context; human probabilities stay explicitly assumed
process_context.leakage: fault labels and future measurements excluded from context input

publication: aggregate results and source metadata only; no participant rows or fitted person-specific models
